decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends the firm's established two-component offer, and the firm keeps showing it publicly, so dropping it would write off the development investment and there is no sign its results cannot be explained by temporary causes.
The injection pump has its own page and a published field-test story from 2021, a visible commitment and long investment that management would want to justify rather than abandon.
The material transfer pumps form a multi-model line built on the proven air motors, so the investment and shared components make the line central and costly to drop.
Fire protection flow monitoring has its own page and supports the firm's announced direction toward digitalized production, so management would attribute any slow uptake to temporary market causes.
The hydraulic two-component system was launched only in 2024 and is close to the core offer, so it is too early to judge it a failure and its weak results can still be called temporary.
